summary: Ellomay Capital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to announce the filing of its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the year ended December 31, 2025. The filing includes a press release highlighting the availability of the annual report and noting minor adjustments to previously published unaudited financial results, such as a decrease in project development costs of approximately $1.5 million and a decrease in tax benefit of about $1.9 million. This is a routine regulatory filing by a foreign private issuer to comply with SEC reporting requirements. No special situation event is triggered. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. It is purely an annual report filing update with no corporate event implications. There are no deal terms to report.
